# Inkra default key bindings

SPEC 10.2 (UI-010). `Ctrl` is `Cmd` (⌘) on macOS. User overrides go to `<config>/keybindings.json` (UI-020).

| Command | Title | Windows / Linux | macOS |

| `file.newWindow` | New Window | `Ctrl+Shift+N` | `⇧⌘N` |
| `file.open` | Open… | `Ctrl+O` | `⌘O` |
| `file.openFolder` | Open Folder… | `Ctrl+Shift+O` |  |
